title: Support for provider-defined tools with Amazon Bedrock
body:
### Feature Description

As per the [Amazon Bedrock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-parameters-anthropic-claude-37.html#model-parameters-anthropic-claude-37-thinking-blocks) docs, there is now support for some "new Anthropic defined tools":

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/79e983fc-5ef0-44e0-9477-6fc0f38979d5)

I poked around and noticed that Bedrock doesn't currently support any provider-defined tools: https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/1040a8882284475423fc0e883220252f97bc00b9/packages/amazon-bedrock/src/bedrock-prepare-tools.ts#L31-L33

This wasn't immediately intuitive to me given that e.g. `text_editor_20250124` works out of the box with `@ai-sdk/anthropic` and then realized it just hasn't been added yet.

Support for this at some point would be great 💪

linked_prs.title: feat(providers/amazon-bedrock): anthropic computer use
linked_prs.body: ## Background Amazon Bedrock provides access to Anthropic's powerful Claude models, which offer advanced features that go beyond standard text generation. These include "Computer Use" tools (Bash, Text Editor, Computer), which allow models to interact with system resources in sophisticated ways. To leverage these features, API requests to Bedrock must include specific `anthropic_beta` headers and use a distinct, provider-specific format for tool configuration. The existing AI SDK Bedrock provider lacked the logic to handle these requirements, preventing users from accessing the full capabilities of Claude models on Bedrock. This PR adds the necessary support to bridge that gap. Amazon Bedrock doesn't not provide support for the Anthropic `web_search` tool however. I have added logic to filter that tool out if provided, and added an `unsupported-tool` warning. ## Summary This pull request introduces comprehensive support for Anthropic’s provider-defined tools (such as Bash and Web Search) when using Anthropic Claude models via Amazon Bedrock in the AI SDK. The key changes are as follows: - **Anthropic Tool Support in Bedrock Provider** - Added logic to the Bedrock provider to recognize when an Anthropic Claude model is being used and route tool configuration and tool choice through Anthropic’s provider-specific mechanism. - Integrated the `@ai-sdk/anthropic` package as a dependency of the Bedrock provider, enabling access to Anthropic tool definitions and preparation logic. - Ensured that the correct `anthropic_beta` HTTP headers are set when required for advanced Anthropic features (“Computer Use” tools and interleaved thinking). - Added test case for new computer use feature - Added documentation with instructions on how to use computer use tools - **Tool Preparation and Validation** - Revised the tool preparation pipeline (`prepareTools` in `bedrock-prepare-tools.ts`) to: - Separate provider-defined tools (Anthropic) from standard function tools. - For Anthropic tools on Anthropic models, leverage the `prepareTools` logic from the `@ai-sdk/anthropic` package, ensuring correct JSON structure and tool_choice formatting. - Validate that only supported configurations are sent (e.g., mixing Anthropic provider-defined tools and standard function tools triggers a warning, and only Anthropic tools are used in that case). - Add warnings for unsupported tool configurations (such as attempting to use Anthropic tools with non-Anthropic models). - **Tool Beta Header Management** - Added tracking of required “beta” features (such as `interleaved-thinking`) and ensured these are collected from the Anthropic tool preparation step and properly included in the outgoing request headers. - **API and Type Enhancements** - Exposed the Anthropic tool definitions directly on the Bedrock provider instance (`provider.tools`), allowing consumers to easily reference and use them. - Updated TypeScript types and interfaces where necessary to reflect the new tool configuration options and beta header management. - **Example Additions and Verification** - Added two new example scripts: - `examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-bash.ts`: Demonstrates use of the Anthropic `bash` tool via Bedrock, including custom execution logic. - `examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-websearch.ts`: Demonstrates an unsuccessful attempt to use the `web_search` tool, highlighting current limitations of Bedrock's Anthropic integration. - Manually verified behavior using these examples, confirming that the `bash` tool works end-to-end and that the `web_search` tool is filtered out and throws a warning (reflecting Bedrock’s current lack of support). - **Dependency and Build System Updates** - Added `@ai-sdk/anthropic` as a dependency and as a TypeScript reference in the Bedrock provider package. - Updated `package.json` and `tsconfig.json` accordingly. ## Verification I manually ran the example `examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-bash.ts` and `examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-websearch.ts`. Interestingly, while `examples/ai-core/src/stream-text/amazon-bedrock-anthropic-websearch.ts` attempts to execute the tool, it doesn't actually succeed: On the other hand, the bash tool is successful: I have since added logic (7fbe26e) to just filter out the `web_search` tool and add a warning. ## Tasks - [x] Tests have been added / updated (for bug fixes / features) - [x] Documentation has been added / updated (for bug fixes / features) - [x] A _patch_ changeset for relevant packages has been added (for bug fixes / features - run `pnpm changeset` in the project root) - [x] Formatting issues have been fixed (run `pnpm prettier-fix` in the project root) ## Future Work - `web_search` does not actually work in amazon bedrock. See this for additional information: https://repost.aws/questions/QUSd3wAByQTtyzUPzgqss3TQ/web-search-for-anthropic-models-in-bedrock#ANYrCHetGqSGm9qznhcDDIag - The `execute` logic for the Computer Use tools is currently left to the user. Future work could involve creating higher-level abstractions or more detailed examples for common use cases, especially for the `computer` tool which involves screen coordinates and actions. - Explore providing more structured error handling and feedback for tool execution failures. One additional thing to note is that Amazon documentation is conflicting on the `Interleaved-thinking` beta: [Here](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-parameters-anthropic-claude-messages-request-response.html) it says `Interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14`: While [here](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/claude-messages-extended-thinking.html), it says `interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14`: ## Related Issues - Fixes #5266 - Fixes #6470 - Related #7572
